why: Options 1-4 all use both triangles and circles together. Option 5 has two triangles inside a rectangle and no circle at all. Option 4 has only one triangle and one circle, but it still has both kinds of shape.
trick: List which basic shapes appear in every figure; the odd one is missing one of them.
